intent: Repair two fail-closed runtime contracts required by the SADHANA release candidate. A denied kernel-wake warrant remains blocked evidence while its already-open idempotency attempt closes with the store's typed failed terminal status and performs no wake. A2A replay resolves one context across the explicit task field, top-level metadata, nested execution-identity metadata, and exact-run durable identity; any disagreement raises before handler or retry mutation, while a context is minted only when every source is empty. This packet performs no provider, transport, deployment, service, VPS, public-route, or other external effect.

gates.name: runtime-contracts-ruff
gates.command: /Users/dhyana/dharma_swarm/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check scripts/runtime/autonomy_spine.py dharma_swarm/a2a/a2a_server.py tests/test_autonomy_spine_cli.py tests/test_a2a_server_retry.py

commit.message: fix(runtime): preserve denied and replayed dispatch contracts

interface_mismatches: Runtime warrants use blocked as evidence modality, while RuntimeState idempotency attempts admit only completed or failed terminal effect statuses; copying the evidence word into the effect store raises after a legitimate denial.
A2AServer currently mints a context before consulting the exact run identity, so a durable retry without the wire context can invent a conflicting context and fail after mutating retry state.

Context may arrive through the task field, top-level metadata, nested execution-identity metadata, or the exact-run durable identity; first-nonempty precedence hides contradictions rather than proving one replay context.
honest_blockers: The focused tests use local SQLite and injected handlers; they do not prove live NATS delivery, provider usefulness, release sealing, or either VPS deployment.
Exact-run lookup proves only the durable identity bound to the supplied run_id; this packet does not add an external-task uniqueness constraint or edit RuntimeState ownership.
A failed idempotency terminal status describes an unperformed effect attempt, while the warrant receipt remains the blocked authority evidence; neither word alone grants retry authority.
No external service, VPS, provider, public route, secret, or Git remote may be mutated by this packet.
session_entry.rollback: Stop SADHANA dispatch and revert the denial-status and A2A-context repairs with their tests as one unit. Do not restore blocked as an idempotency-store status or allow a replay to mint over an exact durable context.
